paragraphs.text: Eutropia , the Twice-Favored is a human wizard on Theros , favored by both Nylea and Thassa .

Eutropia has brown skin and pure white hair which is braided and bound by long red ribbons. Her eyes are milky white, and she has red face paint traced across her face. She wears a white tunic and a winged tiara, and carries one bowl in each hand, one glowing with the green of the forest and the other with the blue of the oceans. Unlike most oracles on Theros, Eutropia is favored by two gods.
